items.q: How is MCP different from calling the API directly?
items.a: APIs are for system integration and automation scripts. MCP wraps steps like draft, submit for review, and schedule publish as tools for agent workflows—permissions and audit rules stay the same; governance is not bypassed.
Title & description templates, canonical URLs, Open Graph / Twitter Card, sitemap & JSON-LD, and more—overridable by channel and environment so multi-site maintenance stays sane.

items.q: Do you support on-premise? Can data stay in-country?
items.a: Yes—private or dedicated cloud, aligned with your network and security policies. Data residency and compliance should be confirmed in writing during pre-sales.

items.q: How do we migrate alongside an existing CMS?
items.a: Usually phased by content model and URL strategy: sync critical sections in parallel, then switch traffic and 301s—with scripted imports and dual-write validation to avoid a risky big bang.

items.q: How do we get a trial or POC?
items.a: Use Contact sales or the About page—share team size, number of sites, and compliance needs. We can arrange a demo, sandbox, or a scoped POC.
